description.value: Panorama Pizza and Curry is a Surrey restaurant serving both pizza and Indian curry dishes, catering to a broad range of tastes under one roof. Cyclists can order ahead online and pick up a hot meal without waiting, or take advantage of the delivery service. The dual-cuisine menu makes it an unusual and practical stop for groups with mixed preferences.
